newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam, Malaysia oilfield to start in July -paper.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam, Malaysia oilfield to start in July -paper.

text.p: Vietnam and Malaysia will start oil production at a field where their maritime territories overlap in early July, the Saigon Times Daily said on Friday.
The newspaper said that potential daily output from the Commercial Arrangement Area known as PM3 had been estimated at 20,000 barrels of oil and 179,000 cubic feet of gas.

Petrovietnam Exploration and Production has 12.5 percent of the venture, Malaysia's national oil firm Petronas 46.06 percent, Canada's International Petroleum Corp 26.44 percent, and Sweden's Sands Petroleum AB 15 percent.
Officials at Petrovietnam and at Petronas in Vietnam declined to comment on the report.
Saigon Times Daily said the partners would drill three to four wells in the first phase, eventually raising the number to 35, and also build a tunnel to transport gas to the mainland.
